source_scope: third_party/crp_online directory snapshot; a third-party Python reproduction, not an exact author reproduction

fitness_protocol.environment: restricted-destination fitness is evaluated by a sequential Numba CPU kernel using float64 and fastmath disabled; the public-frame/environment bridge and byte-preserved source Yard/terminals/compiler remain correctness oracles; a source-Yard Python fallback is available when Numba is unavailable and its backend identity is recorded
fitness_protocol.forecast: clean; each episode's true retrieval order is exposed only through ForecastProvider as the public horizon-20 relative-rank prefix
fitness_protocol.objective: sum of relocation counts over all 840 training episodes
fitness_protocol.relocation_limit: environment safety limit only; no performance cutoff
fitness_protocol.implementation_note: The accelerated scorer maps physical IDs to retrieval-order ranks and applies the explicit public H20 relative-rank/Maximum rule. Its six terminal values, integer AVG, empty-stack INT_MAX DIFF, protected division threshold, and leftmost tie behavior are differentially checked against the byte-preserved source Yard, terminal calculation, and formula compiler. The source GP search engine remains unchanged; the environment/NumPy bridge is retained as an additional correctness reference.
fitness_protocol.relative_rank_adaptation: The source reproduction uses absolute container IDs; this protocol remaps each episode into retrieval-order rank IDs before scoring. This interface adaptation is not an exact author reproduction.

training_bank.role: training and selection only; not an independent validation bank

gp_search.budget_note: The source run_gp initializes 1000 individuals and then evaluates 50 populations of 1000; this is 1000 more evaluations than the retired 50000-evaluation rule contract.
gp_search.cache: within-seed memoization by canonical formula text; source run_gp itself is unchanged
gp_search.selection: lowest best training-bank relocation total across completed seeds; ties choose the smaller seed
gp_search.warm_start: none; no retired GP formula is imported

fixed_h_selection.score: sum relocations on the same 840 training episodes

activation.requires: all 30 complete seed receipts and all five fixed-horizon training scores
activation.partial_runs: must remain pending and must not write an active GP rule
activation.caserta: never used for formula selection, horizon selection, or tuning
